title: 奇幻反派小说封面
author: miwa | AIイラスト・音楽
categories: 漫画 / 分镜,动漫 / 漫画,插画,角色,群像 / 情侣
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a richly detailed Japanese fantasy light-novel cover illustration for a royal villainess romance story, with an ornate ensemble cast arranged around a dramatic central heroine and a fairy-tale castle backdrop.

Canvas: Vertical book-cover composition, 2:3 aspect ratio, polished anime illustration style, extremely detailed, luminous jewel tones, elegant shoujo fantasy atmosphere, no modern objects.

Layout: Use a dense poster-like composition with exactly 9 visible characters layered in depth around the page. The central lower-right figure is the main heroine, surrounded by noble men and women in a royal court setting. Place a white castle with tall blue spires in the upper center background, framed by a grand arched window or palace arch. Add an ornate gold filigree border around all edges. Scatter glowing blue-purple crystal shards, pink rose petals, and magical sparkles throughout the image. Place the main Japanese title across the lower-left to center area, partially overlapping the characters, with a small subtitle beneath it.

Characters: Include exactly 9 characters: 1) central heroine, a glamorous black-haired noblewoman in a dark emerald and black off-shoulder gown with lace, gold chains, emerald jewelry, jeweled hair ornaments, and a poised villainess aura; 2) central white-haired nobleman in a black military-style coat with gold trim, chains, brooches, and a serious romantic-lead presence; 3) top-left red-haired armored knight in dark red and silver armor with a fur mantle and jeweled shoulder ornament; 4) top-right blond prince in a navy-blue high-collared uniform with elaborate gold chains and epaulets; 5) left-side silver-haired lady in a dark navy noble outfit, elegant and reserved; 6) right-side blonde princess in a pale blue frilled gown with floral hair accessories; 7) mid-right dark-haired nobleman in a dark suit with red tie, partially turned away; 8) bottom-left black-haired young nobleman in a black suit with gold trim and a red tie, looking intense; 9) bottom-right blond nobleman in a white-and-gold ceremonial uniform with red sash, gloved hand near his face. Keep all faces beautiful anime-style and expressive.

Text content: Add the large Japanese title 悪役令嬢は 今世こそ 幸せになりたい in elegant calligraphic typography, with the first and last major words in deep red and purple gradients and the smaller connecting words in black. Add the small subtitle 断罪される人生なんて、もうこりごりですから。 centered below the title in delicate black Japanese type. Decorative flourishes should surround the text like a real fantasy novel cover.

Visual style: Highly polished romantic anime cover art, intricate linework, glossy highlights, sparkling magical crystals, purple roses at the bottom, lavish gold ornaments, cinematic lighting, soft sky-blue and violet background, dramatic depth, luxurious royal-fantasy mood. Use long glossy black hair for the heroine, silver white hair for the main male lead, and royal navy, violet, emerald, gold, and icy blue as the dominant palette.

Constraints: Make it look like a finished Japanese fantasy romance novel cover, not a character sheet. Preserve exactly 9 characters, one castle, one ornate border, many crystals, many rose petals, and several purple roses at the bottom. Do not add logos, watermarks, author names, barcode, or extra text beyond the title and subtitle.\

Each row has a black instruction sidebar on the left taking about one quarter of the width, with the corresponding cinematic frame on the right. Use thin divider lines between rows. Add bold white italic subtitle-style text over the bottom of the video frames where specified.

Subject details: A young woman with medium skin tone, dark hair in a messy bun, small gold hoop earrings, wearing a red Portugal football jersey with green trim and a large white number 7. The back of the jersey reads RONALDO above the number 7. Her face is anonymized with a smooth brown rectangular blur in shots where her face is visible. She carries a black sling bag in the leaving-home scene.

Shot count and exact content:
1. SHOT 1, time 0:00–0:04: Interior apartment mirror shot. The woman stands in front of a tall rounded mirror, checking her Portugal #7 Ronaldo jersey, fixing her hair, and making finger-guns at her reflection with a grin. Warm bedroom/apartment decor, plants, a framed Ronaldo poster in the background. On-frame subtitle: Match day. Let’s go. 🇵🇹⚽
2. SHOT 2, time 0:04–0:08: Rear tracking shot from behind as she walks to the apartment door in slow motion, wearing the jersey with RONALDO and 7 visible, black sling bag on shoulder, right hand opening the door handle. No on-frame subtitle.
3. SHOT 3, time 0:08–0:11: Door opens to extremely bright sunlight. She squints, raises one hand to block the sun, looks upward, and mouths “Oh no.” Strong lens flare and sunburst from outside, city buildings faintly visible. On-frame subtitle: That sun is NOT it ☀️😬
4. SHOT 4, time 0:11–0:15: Sunscreen application sequence composed of exactly 3 side-by-side visuals within the right frame: left visual shows her holding sunscreen and applying cream to her face confidently; middle visual is a clear product close-up of a tube labeled mamaearth Vitamin C Daily Glow Sunscreen, SPF 50 PA+++; right visual is a macro close-up of a green-capped sunscreen tube squeezing white cream onto fingertips. On-frame subtitle across the bottom: Mamaearth SPF — match day essential 🌿

Left sidebar text: For each row, include white uppercase headings and compact production notes. SHOT 1 sidebar: “SHOT 1”, “0:00–0:04”, “ACTION / DIALOGUE: Checks jersey, fixes hair, finger guns mirror, grabs sling bag.” “CAMERA / MOVEMENT: Front mirror shot, slight push-in.” “TEXT ON SCREEN: ‘Match day. Let’s go. 🇵🇹⚽’”. SHOT 2 sidebar: “SHOT 2”, “0:04–0:08”, “ACTION / DIALOGUE: Walks to door in slow motion, opens it.” “CAMERA / MOVEMENT: Tracking from behind, slow motion.” “TEXT ON SCREEN: (none)”. SHOT 3 sidebar: “SHOT 3”, “0:08–0:11”, “ACTION / DIALOGUE: Squints at sunlight, looks at arms, looks up, mouths ‘Oh no.’” “CAMERA / MOVEMENT: Push-in as door opens, lens flare.” “TEXT ON SCREEN: ‘That sun is NOT it ☀️😬’”. SHOT 4 sidebar: “SHOT 4”, “0:11–0:15”, “ACTION / DIALOGUE: Pulls out Mamaearth SPF, shows it, squeezes cream, applies on face confidently.” “CAMERA / MOVEMENT: Close-up to macro product + application.” “TEXT ON SCREEN: ‘Mamaearth SPF — match day essential 🌿’”. Highlight the text-on-screen quotes in warm yellow.

Visual style: Realistic ad storyboard, sharp but cinematic, warm golden light, cozy apartment plants and wooden furniture, shallow depth of field, natural skin tones, high-quality product photography for the sunscreen tube. Keep the layout clean and readable, with no watermark and no extra shots beyond the 4 specified rows.\
